entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was raining as Serge dropped me..."
entries.dialogueText: It was raining as Serge dropped me off at home after yet another gruelling day of work.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A guard held an umbrella over my he..."
entries.dialogueText: A guard held an umbrella over my head as I walked from the car to my front door. Inside, the house was completely dark.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I flipped on the light in the kitch..."
entries.dialogueText: I flipped on the light in the kitchen to find a note from Monica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara had called her in for a last-..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara had called her in for a last-minute women's rights meeting. She'd dropped Deana off at a friend's and left me some food for reheating.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She'd gone to visit her parents for..."
entries.dialogueText: She'd gone to visit her parents for the night, bringing Deana along with her. They'd left me some food I could reheat for dinner.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took the pot out of the fridge. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the pot out of the fridge. It was filled with an unidentifiable grayish-looking stew. Evidently, Monica's excellent cooking had been the first casualty of her political career.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took the pot out of the fridge. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the pot out of the fridge. It was filled with an unidentifiable grayish-looking stew. Evidently, my wife was still upset with me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sighed and put the pot on the sto..."
entries.dialogueText: I sighed and put the pot on the stove.
entries.menuText: Reheat the stew.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I called Serge and asked him to pic..."
entries.dialogueText: I called Serge and asked him to pick me up a pizza for dinner.
entries.menuText: Order a pizza.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While it was heating up, I went to..."
entries.dialogueText: While it was heating up, I went to the living room to fix myself a drink.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While I was waiting for him, I went..."
entries.dialogueText: While I was waiting for him, I went into the living room to fix myself a drink.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, the phone rang. I went ba..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, the phone rang. I went back to the kitchen and answered it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc's voice was on the other end."
entries.dialogueText: Franc's voice was on the other end.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Oh. I thought Mom would pick up.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. I thought Mom would pick up."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your mother works harder than I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your mother works harder than I do these days."
entries.menuText: "Your mother works harder than I do these days."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Oh, right. She was actually in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, right. She was actually in the papers over here. They're calling her 'fierce'."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a long silence."
entries.dialogueText: There was a long silence.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Oh, right. My commander's worried..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, right. My commander's worried women might be allowed into the military now. He thinks they're too emotional to serve."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Oh, right. Deana's going to have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, right. Deana's going to have a fit if she gets rid of girls' handicraft classes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""She's off on her ladies' crusade,..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's off on her ladies' crusade, as usual."
entries.menuText: "She's off on her ladies' crusade, as usual."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry, you're stuck with your old..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, you're stuck with your old man."
entries.menuText: "Sorry, you're stuck with your old man."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hello to you too, Franc.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hello to you too, Franc."
entries.menuText: "Hello to you too, Franc."

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.dialogueText: "Sorry! Hi, Dad. Glad to catch you out of the office."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Ugh. Great.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ugh. Great."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I didn't mean it that way! I just..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't mean it that way! I just figured you'd be working."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Uh... I got that record you sent m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... I got that record you sent me. Not bad for old folks' music."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Have you heard anything from Uncle..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you heard anything from Uncle Petr?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""How's Uncle Petr doing?""
entries.dialogueText: "How's Uncle Petr doing?"

entries.menuText: "Say hi to him for me."

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.dialogueText: "Wow. Did I just see a pig fly?"

entries.dialogueText: "You know the military's worried about things escalating with Rumburg since you threw Livia in jail. They're moving more and more troops up near Mougwer."

entries.dialogueText: "Queen Beatrice will back off if she knows what's good for her."
entries.menuText: "Queen Beatrice will back off if she knows what's good for her."

entries.dialogueText: "I'll see what I can do to alleviate tensions. The last thing I want is my son going into battle."
entries.menuText: "I'll see what I can do to alleviate tensions. The last thing I want is my son going into battle."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rumburg instigated aggression agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg instigated aggression against us. It must face the consequences."
entries.menuText: "Rumburg instigated aggression against us. It must face the consequences."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "No, it would've been too risky."
entries.menuText: "No, it would've been too risky."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "Ha! Never."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I know, Dad. I'm ready to fight if..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Dad. I'm ready to fight if I have to."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I'm ready to fight if I have to.""

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""So you do care about me, now that..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Even if that means sacrificing you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if that means sacrificing your only son. Got it."

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.dialogueText: "I have, actually. But some of the older guys are getting transferred up by Mougwer. In case things escalate with Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Absence makes the heart grow fonde..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absence makes the heart grow fonder."
entries.menuText: "Absence makes the heart grow fonder."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I always did.""
entries.dialogueText: "I always did."
entries.menuText: "I always did."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I've been taking part in some of t..."

entries.menuText: "What?! You'll make me look like an idiot!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good for you. Exercise your right..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""You-- you're not mad at me?""
entries.dialogueText: "You-- you're not mad at me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If you have a problem with the way..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you have a problem with the way I'm doing things, take it up with me in person."
entries.menuText: "If you have a problem with the way I'm doing things, take it up with me in person."

entries.title: Player: ""Stop protesting, or I'll personall..."

entries.menuText: "Stop protesting, or I'll personally order Karl to go over there and beat the shit out of every last one of you."

entries.dialogueText: "Not everyone can get a personal audience with the President of Sordland, Dad. It sends a more powerful message if I'm there with my fellow citizens."

entries.title: Franc: ""My head's been stuffed with Sordis..."
entries.dialogueText: "My head's been stuffed with Sordish propaganda since the day I was born. Right now I feel like I'm thinking clearly for the first time."

entries.dialogueText: "But I feel like you know that already."

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.title: Narrator: "I suddenly became aware of a smoky..."
entries.dialogueText: I suddenly became aware of a smoky smell coming from the kitchen. My dinner was burning.
